COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
BA2 No.297 of 2022
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. M.K. Ray, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. T.C. Agarwal, Deputy Advocate
General for the State.
The 1st Bail Application preferred by the
applicant was rejected by me on 01.09.2022.
The applicant is an accused for commission of
offence under Sections 363 and 376 of IPC and
5/6 of the POCSO Act, and the age of the victim
at the time of incident was 10 years.
The incident is said to have been
committed at 1.00 p.m. and the victim in her
statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has clearly
stated the involvement of the present applicant
in commission of offence.
Except for the distinction which has been
argued by the learned counsel for the applicant
with regard to the period of sentence which the
applicant has already served, there is no other
new ground which has been taken in the 2nd
Bail Application.
In such type of crucial offence which has
got a social bearing particularly a mental
bearing on mind the period of sentence
becomes irrelevant.
For the aforesaid reasons and looking to
the gravity of offence and the manner in which
it has been committed by the present applicant,

I am not inclined to grant bail to the present
applicant; the bail application is, accordingly,
rejected.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 24.05.2023
Ravi
